turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = b1*(1-exp[-b2*x]) to the data in boxbod.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 1, b2 = 1. Report every parameter (b1, b2) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD BoxBOD (public domain), data copied verbatim
